d: IGS-624HPT Industrial 4-Port 10/100/1000T 802.3at PoE + 2-Port 100/1000X SFP Ethernet Switch

specs.label: PoE Injector Ports
specs.value: Four ports with 802.3at PoE+ injector function (Ports 1 to 4)

specs.label: Connector
specs.value: Removable 6-pin terminal block Pin 1/2 for Power 1; Pin 3/4 for fault alarm; Pin 5/6 for Power 2

specs.label: Power Requirements
specs.value: 12~54V DC, 7A (max.) Redundant power with reverse polarity protection

specs.label: Alarm
specs.value: Provides one relay output for power failure Alarm relay current carry ability: 1A @ 24V DC
